title: Empanelment Questionnaire: Branch Refurbishment Contractors, South Zone
scope: Refurbishment of existing branches while operational: interiors, counters, false ceiling, lighting, signage coordination, ATM lobby finishes. Branches between 1,200 and 2,500 sq ft.

questions.text: Name of the firm
Type of entity
Year established
Address of the office nearest to Hyderabad
Single point of contact for this empanelment
Contact number
GSTIN
PAN number
Brief profile of the promoter and years of experience in the trade
Turnover for the preceding three financial years
Banker's name and branch
Banker's solvency certificate (attach)
Audited accounts for the last three years (attach)
Manpower strength
Describe supervisory staff available for Hyderabad sites
Source of modular furniture and counters: in-house or outsourced
Experience in refurbishing bank branches, with client names and number of branches
Can you carry out refurbishment while the branch remains open to customers? Describe how
Are you able to work at night and on Sundays? State any constraints
Experience with ATM lobby or kiosk fit-outs, if any
Largest single work order executed: client, value, year
Works currently in hand
Completion certificates for bank or NBFC works (attach)
Number of branches you can handle at the same time in the South Zone
Expected completion time for a 1,500 sq ft branch refurbishment in two phases
Do you have signage vendor tie-ups? Name them
ISO 9001 certified? (attach certificate)
Do you have a written HSE policy? (attach)
Defect liability period offered on workmanship
Insurance cover carried: contractor's all-risk, workmen's compensation
PF registration (attach)
ESI registration (attach)
Any blacklisting, debarment or pending litigation? Declare
GST certificate (attach)
Firm registration certificate (attach)
